language.name: English
nav.label: Settings sections
general.buddyShortcut: Show {pip} the window under the mouse
update.title: Updates
update.autoHint: from GitHub Releases; they install when Pebble restarts
update.off: A local build: no updates (installed copies update themselves)
notify.title: Notifications
notify.toastsHint: when an agent finishes or needs you
island.gameMode: Hide while something is full screen
island.skinsHint: glows hot when the processor works hard, a spider web at night, vines after a long day
pip.name: Name
agents.permissions: Answer Claude Code's permission questions on the island
terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.hint: tell me when a long command finishes
chat.whoHint: the Claude Code and Codex choices use your own plan, no key needed
chat.modelHint: the list comes from the provider
chat.readAloudHint: with Windows' voices; the speaker on each answer reads it too
chat.keysHint: kept encrypted on this PC, sent only to that provider
apps.title: Chat apps (experimental)
apps.hint: see when claude.ai, ChatGPT, Gemini or DeepSeek answered, and reply from the island
apps.warning: They read those sites in your own browser and type for you, which the terms of OpenAI, Anthropic and others forbid for their chat apps (automated access): using them may put your chat account at risk. They are off until you set them up.
apps.browserHint: 1. Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions), switch on Developer mode, "Load unpacked" and pick the folder below. 2. Paste the key into Pebble's extension.
apps.desktopHint: beta: reads the app's window, so an app update can break it
apps.emptyOnly: a reply is typed into its message box only when that box is empty
extras.lyricsHint: from LRCLIB: only title, artist, album and length are sent
guard.title: Focus guard
guard.enabled: A breath before distracting apps and sites
guard.sitesHint: one per line: a program name, or a word in the browser tab's title
advanced.sceneHint: plays a made-up session on the island
advanced.portHint: restart Pebble after changing; agents reconnect on their own
diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.hint: checks every part of Pebble on this PC; nothing is sent anywhere
welcome.title: Welcome to Pebble
welcome.hello: Hi! I live in the island at the top of your screen.
welcome.helloHint: I show what your AI agents are doing, and much more. A few questions and we are set.
welcome.agentsHint: The ones found on this PC are switched on. You can change this later in Settings.
welcome.terminals: Shall I tell you when a long command finishes?
welcome.terminalsHint: I add a few lines to these shells. New terminals only.
welcome.name: What do you want to call me?
welcome.nameHint: You can change it any time.
welcome.readyHint: Point at the island to open it. {toggle} opens it from anywhere, {buddy} shows me a window.
i.status.question: Needs you
i.agents.none: No agent sessions yet. Start Claude Code or Codex in a terminal.
i.island.dropHere: Drop to keep it on the shelf
i.clip.empty: Texts you copy show up here (only while Pebble runs; passwords from password managers are skipped).
i.focus.running: Focus time. The island shows the ring around Pip.
i.music.nothing: Nothing is playing. Start music in any app (Spotify, a browser, …) and it shows here.
i.widgets.none: No connectors are on. Settings → Connectors: GitHub, weather, live scores, your calendar, news feeds, a value to watch, a webhook inbox, DeepSeek balance, Windows apps, or your own.
i.files.how: Same Wi-Fi as this PC. Your phone can save what is on the shelf, and “Send to PC” puts photos and files in Downloads and here.
i.files.public: This network is set to Public, so Windows blocks your phone. On a café or hotel Wi-Fi, keep it that way.
i.files.firewall: Windows Firewall may block your phone.
i.files.makePrivate: It is my own network: make it Private
i.files.notOpening: Not opening? Your phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this PC (not a guest network) with mobile data off.
i.files.empty: Drag files onto the island to keep them here for a while. Drag them out again into any app.
i.chat.empty: Ask {name} anything. “Look” shows him a window.
i.word.done: {done}. Accept or reject them in Word (Review).
m.buddyHint: Point at a window, then press the shortcut.
m.focusOverBody: {n} minutes done. Take a short break.
m.planReady: A plan is ready for you
m.updateReadyBody: It installs when Pebble restarts (tray → Restart to update).
c.apps.name: Windows apps
c.apps.desc: Shows when an app you list is open (a call in Teams or Zoom, a recording in OBS…), from the titles of open windows. Nothing leaves this PC.
c.apps.watch: Words to look for: "program" or "program: words in the title", e.g. "zoom", "teams: meeting", "obs64"
c.calendar.name: Calendar
c.calendar.desc: Your next event from a calendar link (the secret iCal address of Google Calendar or Outlook), and a heads-up a few minutes before.
c.calendar.ics: The calendar's secret iCal (.ics) address (stored encrypted)
c.calendar.remindMinutes: Remind me this many minutes before
c.deepseek.name: DeepSeek balance
c.deepseek.desc: Your DeepSeek API balance as a chip, with a warning when it runs low.
c.deepseek.lowBelow: Warn when the balance is below
c.github.name: GitHub
c.github.desc: Reviews waiting for you, your notifications, and a heads-up when CI fails on one of your open pull requests.
c.github.token: A GitHub token (read access to notifications and pull requests; stored encrypted)
c.rss.name: News feeds (RSS)
c.rss.desc: The newest items of RSS or Atom feeds you choose, with a notification for each new one.
c.scores.name: Live scores
c.scores.desc: Your team's match live in the island (score and minute), with a notification for every goal. From ESPN's unofficial scoreboard endpoint (no account; not a documented API, so it may stop working).
c.scores.team: Your team, e.g. Arsenal, Ajax, Real Madrid
c.scores.league: ESPN league code: eng.1 (Premier League), ned.1, esp.1, uefa.champions, or nba / nfl / nhl / mlb
c.watch.name: Watch a value
c.watch.desc: Watches one value on the web (a price, a status, a count) as a chip and a card, with a notification when it changes.
c.watch.url: Address of the page or API (https://…)
c.watch.path: The value to watch (press Find values and pick it)
c.watch.label: What it is, e.g. BTC
c.weather.name: Weather
c.weather.desc: The weather where you are, from Open-Meteo (free, no account). A chip with the temperature, and a heads-up when rain is coming.
c.weather.rainAlert: Tell me when rain is coming in the next hour
c.webhook.name: Webhook inbox
c.webhook.desc: A local web address anything can POST to (scripts, n8n, CI on this PC): {"title", "text"} becomes a notification; with "progress" (0-100) it shows live in the island.
o.night-owl: Night owl: a task done between midnight and 5
m.speechFailedBody: Windows has no voice for this, or speech is not available. Settings → Time & language → Speech adds voices.
look.iconHint: the tray and Pebble's windows; the installer and its shortcut keep lavender
pipLook.title: {name}'s look
pipLook.hint: how he looks in the island
